title: The internet needs a nap (and you do, too)
description: CVE-2026-114938, dubbed "Java4Shell," is a critical vulnerability in OpenJDK that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via malformed Base64 input. It affects OpenJDK Java versions 17.0.6 and later running on x86-64 CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI support enabled. No in-the-wild exploitation has been observed yet, but successful tests against Java applications have been reported. The vulnerability impacts a large potential attack surface including both on-premise and cloud environments. Mitigation includes applying software updates or disabling AVX-512 support on the JVM with a specific startup flag. Detection rules for network monitoring are also recommended.
